init.title: Sharing the Jackery login
init.description: Jackery allows one sign-in per account. When the Jackery app signs in, Home Assistant is signed out. Choose how long Home Assistant waits before signing back in (which signs the app out). Use the Reclaim Jackery Session button to sign back in sooner. 0 = never wait: Home Assistant signs straight back in.
